component.name: Grok Bot (Unofficial)
component.summary: Unofficial community Linux packaging of Grok Bot

description.p: Unofficial community Linux packaging of Grok Bot for Flatpak. This is not an official xAI or Cursor release and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by those companies.
Grok Bot is proprietary software. You need an eligible subscription (for example Cursor Ultra or SuperGrok Heavy) to sign in and use it.
Use at your own risk. Redistribution may conflict with upstream terms of service.
Initial unofficial Flatpak packaging of Grok Bot 0.18.0 for Linux x86_64.
